# Valentiam Group

> > Valentiam Group provides transfer pricing, business valuation, and international tax consulting services for multinational enterprises navigating OECD guidelines, IRS compliance, and cross-border transactions.

Valentiam specializes in transfer pricing solutions, advance pricing agreements (APAs), intellectual property valuation, dispute resolution, and tax compliance. The firm serves clients across diverse industries including cannabis, with expertise in OECD BEPS frameworks, GILTI, and global minimum tax regulations.

## Key Topics

- Transfer Pricing
- OECD BEPS Pillar One & Pillar Two
- Business Valuation
- International Tax Compliance
- Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs)
- Intellectual Property Valuation
- IRS Audit Defense
- Global Minimum Tax
- EBITDA Multiples
- Dispute Resolution
- Tax Reform
- Cannabis Industry Compliance
- Commercial Property Valuation
- Shareholder Disputes
- GILTI Regulations
